Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; curated Effect/Ability IDs, never inferred from prose.

Cards.Name: Scorn the Weak
Cards.Text:
Battle: Target an enemy Personality: Give him -5F. If his Force is now 0, his controller loses 1 Honor and you may target and dishonor a Personality.
Battle: Target an enemy Personality: Give him -5F. If his Force is now 0, his controller loses 1 Honor and you may target and dishonor a Personality.

Cards.Name: Strength in Terror
Cards.Text: Battle: Choose your performing Paragon and target an enemy Personality: Reduce his Force by an amount equal to your Paragon's Force. You may target and destroy one of the Personality's attachments. Lose 3 Honor.

Cards.Name: Strength of Purity
Cards.Text: Battle: Choose your performing Personality with 3 or higher Personal Honor: Give him +3F.

Cards.Name: Strength of the Bear
Cards.Text: Battle: Bow your target unbowed Personality. Bow a target enemy card with lower Force than his. If your Personality has 5 or more printed Force, straighten him.

Cards.Name: Strength of the Divine
Cards.Text:
Battle: Target your opposed unbowed Paragon. Give him +2F or +2PH. Melee Attack with strength equal to his Force or Personal Honor.
.

Cards.Name: The Strength of the Spider
Cards.Text:
As a Focus Effect: You may choose (now) to delay the effects of losing this duel until after the next Dynasty Phase begins.
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Spider Clan Personality and target an enemy Personality or Follower: Destroy it if it is bowed. Reduce its Force by an amount equal to your Personality's Force. Bow it if its Force is now 0.

Cards.Name: Unexpected
Cards.Text:
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Personality and target an enemy card without attachments: Bow it. You may bow your Personality; if you did, draw a card.
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Personality and target an enemy card without attachments: Bow it. You may bow your Personality; if you did, draw a card.
